text: If I had a ladder, I would climb up to a platter full of home-made muffins and jam. Home, how lonesome I am. Oh, I got the home again blue. When I left home, I didn't have a cent. Was a croak, but I was badly bent. Didn't have a single dime to count. Now I'm going home.
